Latency, Capex & 280x Price Decomposition — Plug power = 1.5%–11.8% of H100e hourly cost · 280x / (2x × 2x) = 70x (~74x; ~141x vs capex alone) software-driven price drop (unmetered)

Across 74 Epoch AI sites, plug electricity is 1.5%-11.8% of hourly H100e cost (capex is 8x-70x larger). Dividing the >280x GPT-3.5 price drop by both ~2x hardware trends leaves 70x (~74x; ~141x vs capex).
